svg.title: Every Cg depends on the test only through its germ at the normally collapsed point x −πgx. This follows from (CE2) in each summand of (CE16); for a singleton its normal space is zero. Now compare two partitions Q, R which are both separated on a test support. Expanding Q i∈Q Si gives precisely the terms Q j∈T Cj over all partitions T refining Q: choosing a partition separately inside every part of Q is bijective with choosing a refinement. The same holds for R. A term refining Q
